agent_docs_btn.tooltip: Open the documentation for the currently active agent.

cost_history_btn.tooltip: Open the Cost History dialog (charts and tables of past spending).

daily_budget_input.tooltip: Maximum spend allowed per day in euros. Press Enter to save; 0 means no limit.

daily_meter.limit_input.tooltip: Maximum spend allowed per day in euros. Press Enter to save; 0 means no limit.

history_list.tooltip: Click a saved chat to re-open it. Right-click to rename, assign or remove it.

history_search.tooltip: Filter saved chats by typing here.

learn_btn.tooltip: Open the Learning Centre — controls, income experiments, automation playbooks, measurement, and fixes.

model_updates_card.check_btn.tooltip: Ask each provider with a key for its model list. Free: model lists are not billed.

model_updates_card.dismiss_btn.tooltip: Clear every notice without switching to anything. The models stay in the menus and are not announced again.

model_updates_card.media_dismiss_btn.tooltip: Clear new and removed video and image notices. Shutdown dates stay until the date has passed.

model_updates_card.update_btn.tooltip: Switch agents to the marked models — only where each agent's current task is assessed (fit and real price) as best served by it: overall, or within the provider the agent is already on. Being new is not a reason to switch. Unmarked models stay as notices.

new_chat_btn.tooltip: Start a fresh conversation (clears the current context).

project_defaults_btn.tooltip: Use this agent, provider and model when this project is opened.

project_overview_btn.tooltip: See this Project's working draft, linked files and Creator content.

realtime_monitor_btn.tooltip: (Coming soon) Live charts of system resource usage.

reset_session_budget_btn.tooltip: Reset the session spend counter back to zero.

run_log_btn.tooltip: Open the Run Log dialog (every request with status, duration, cost).

session_budget_input.tooltip: Maximum spend allowed for this session in euros. Press Enter to save; 0 means no limit.

session_meter.limit_input.tooltip: Maximum spend allowed for this session in euros. Press Enter to save; 0 means no limit.

settings_btn.tooltip: Open the Settings dialog (pricing, agents, tools, EUR/USD rate).

tooltips_toggle_btn.tooltip: Toggle hover tooltips across the entire app.

workspace_more_btn.tooltip: Workspaces that do not fit in the header
